method.profile: release; thin LTO; one codegen unit; pinned Rust; build jobs 2
method.order: Alternating before/after processes, reversed middle pair. No compilation or other qualification ran during measurements.
method.page_reference: SQL equivalent to the former OFFSET/recount path with identical metadata decoding; selected IDs, page lengths and totals checked on every iteration.
method.storage: Fresh controlled Feed bodies of 2080 bytes; 2000 and 13000 articles. Each of eight diagnostics validates exact source and FTS bytes; no personal library was inspected.
method.discovery: Three independent runs per binary; 100 quiet Miniflux feeds, one publisher, one other server delaying discovery by 800 ms. First successful feed persistence polled via existing owner SQL every 2 ms. Setup/adoption excluded; timing begins just after process launch.
limits: Synthetic single-machine fixtures do not establish end-to-end latency for every library/network.
Page hints invalidate on any database revision; ranked/grouped/recommended ordering and direct jumps retain OFFSET fallback.
Cancellation is cooperative: third-party parsing, fitting and quantization calls finish before their next checkpoint.
Image preparation medians range from small improvements to small regressions; no direct encoding speedup is claimed.
Cache accounting is conservative and excludes separately bounded decoder sources and transient encoder pixels.
Global Miniflux batching was investigated and remains disabled pending an account-wide cursor design; implemented collection remains per feed.
method.benchmark_source: SQL reference fragments were relocated to the owning sql/ directory before the final benchmark build; the source checksums below identify the measured harness.
